idea: A service that lets restaurants sell surplus food to nearby people at a discount before closing

event.concept: Sell perishable inventory at a discount shortly before it expires

industry.name: Airlines: last-minute seats
industry.why: Perishable inventory sold at a discount as departure nears.

industry.name: Hotels: unsold rooms
industry.why: An empty room tonight earns nothing, so late deals fill it.

industry.name: Events: unsold tickets
industry.why: Tickets expire at showtime, so day-of discounts recover revenue.

industry.name: Retail: clearance
industry.why: Overstock is marked down to move before it loses value.

industry.name: Energy: off-peak power
industry.why: Surplus supply is priced low to shift demand to quiet hours.
